title: Replace landing page car image with tuner import style car

requirements.summary: Replace the existing car image on the landing page hero section with a newly generated tuner import style car image
acceptanceCriteria: The landing page displays a tuner/import style car image (e.g., lowered Japanese sport compact with aftermarket body kit, wide-body styling, racing livery, or similar JDM/import tuner aesthetic)
The old car image is replaced by the new generated image
The image renders correctly across desktop and mobile viewports

file_operations.description: Replace the existing hero section car image source with the generated tuner import style car image at frontend/public/assets/generated/tuner-car-hero.dim_1200x600.png. Update the image element to reference the new asset path and ensure responsive rendering across desktop and mobile viewports using appropriate CSS classes.
